{{Top|leg}}
'''Station 47A''' was a station in the [[Imperial records library|Imperial Library]], located on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

Sometime in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] were to Station 47A while looking for a copy of the [[Caamas Document]].<ref name="Vision of the Future" />
